ucs.title: [LLM] Akira (Howling Scorpius) Rclone-to-Mega exfiltration following AnyDesk/RustDesk drop
ucs.description: Hunts Akira's signature pre-encryption exfil chain: an interactive RMM (AnyDesk/RustDesk/Ngrok/Cloudflared) installed for hands-on operator access, followed by rclone.exe copying staged data to a Mega.nz remote. CISA AA24-109A, Sophos and SentinelOne all identify this exact rclone→mega.nz pattern as Akira's near-universal exfil-before-encrypt playbook (also used by GOLD SAHARA/PUNK SPIDER clusters).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="rclone.exe" OR Processes.original_file_name="rclone.exe") AND (Processes.process="*mega*" OR Processes.process="*--config*" OR Processes.process="*--multi-thread-streams*" OR Processes.process="*--transfers*" OR Processes.process="*--no-check-certificate*" OR Processes.process="* copy *" OR Processes.process="* sync *") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | join type=left dest [| tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as rmmFirstSeen values(Processes.process_name) as rmm_tool from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("anydesk.exe","rustdesk.exe","ngrok.exe","cloudflared.exe","radmin.exe","meshagent.exe") by Processes.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where rmmFirstSeen < relative_time(now(),"-0s")] | where isnotnull(rmm_tool) AND (lastTime - rmmFirstSeen) < 86400 | eval delta_hours=round((lastTime - rmmFirstSeen)/3600,1) | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) ctime(rmmFirstSeen) | table firstTime, lastTime, dest, user, rmm_tool, rmmFirstSeen, delta_hours, cmdline, parent | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let RmmCorrelationWindow = 24h;
let RmmTools = dynamic(["anydesk.exe","rustdesk.exe","ngrok.exe","cloudflared.exe","radmin.exe","meshagent.exe"]);
let ExfilDomains = dynamic(["mega.nz","mega.co.nz","userstorage.mega.co.nz","gfs.userstorage.mega.co.nz","megaup.net"]);
let RmmHosts =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ (RmmTools)
    | summarize RmmFirstSeen = min(Timestamp), RmmTool = any(FileName) by DeviceId, DeviceName;
let RcloneProc =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (FileName =~ "rclone.exe" or ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName =~ "rclone.exe")
         or (ProcessCommandLine has_any ("mega:","--multi-thread-streams","--transfers") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("copy ","sync ","move "))
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project ProcTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitiatingProcessCommandLine, SHA256;
RcloneProc
| join kind=inner RmmHosts on DeviceId
| where ProcTime between (RmmFirstSeen .. RmmFirstSeen + RmmCorrelationWindow)
| extend MinutesAfterRMM = datetime_diff('minute', ProcTime, RmmFirstSeen)
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "rclone.exe"
    | where RemoteUrl has_any (ExfilDomains) or RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | summarize ExfilBytes = sum(toint(column_ifexists("AdditionalFields", 0))),
                ExfilDest = make_set(RemoteUrl, 20),
                NetEventCount = count() by DeviceId
) on DeviceId
| project ProcTime, DeviceName, AccountName, RmmTool, RmmFirstSeen, MinutesAfterRMM,
          ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ExfilDest, NetEventCount, SHA256
| order by ProcTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let RmmCorrelationWindow = 24h;
let RmmTools = dynamic(["anydesk.exe","rustdesk.exe","ngrok.exe","cloudflared.exe","radmin.exe","meshagent.exe"]);
let ExfilHosts = dynamic(["mega.nz","mega.co.nz","userstorage.mega.co.nz","gfs.userstorage.mega.co.nz","megaup.net"]);
let RmmFirstSeen =
    ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActingProcessName has_any (RmmTools) or TargetProcessName has_any (RmmTools)
    | summarize RmmFirst = min(TimeGenerated), RmmTool = any(ActingProcessName)
             by DvcHostname;
let RcloneExec =
    ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActingProcessName endswith "rclone.exe"
         or (ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("mega:","--multi-thread-streams","--transfers")
             and ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("copy ","sync ","move "))
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | project ProcTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
              ActingProcessCommandLine, ParentProcessName, SHA256;
RcloneExec
| join kind=inner RmmFirstSeen on DvcHostname
| where ProcTime between (RmmFirst .. RmmFirst + RmmCorrelationWindow)
| extend MinutesAfterRMM = datetime_diff('minute', ProcTime, RmmFirst)
| join kind=leftouter (
    ImDnsActivity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where DnsQuery has_any (ExfilHosts)
    | summarize ExfilQueries = make_set(DnsQuery, 20), QueryCount = count() by DvcHostname
) on DvcHostname
| project ProcTime, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, RmmTool, RmmFirst, MinutesAfterRMM,
          ActingProcessCommandLine, ParentProcessName, ExfilQueries, QueryCount, SHA256
| order by ProcTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Akira Rclone-to-Mega Exfiltration
id: 7c4b2d10-2e0e-4c4f-92a1-1f6b3b6c9a01
status: experimental
description: Detects rclone.exe invoking copy/sync against a Mega remote — Akira's signature pre-encryption exfil pattern.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-109a
author: SOC Detection Eng
date: 2026/06/03
tags:
  - attack.exfiltration
  - attack.t1567.002
  - attack.g1024
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\rclone.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'mega:'
      - '--multi-thread-streams'
      - '--transfers'
  selection_verb:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' copy '
      - ' sync '
      - ' move '
  filter_machine_acct:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_img and selection_cmd and selection_verb and not filter_machine_acct
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate IT backups to Mega — uncommon in enterprise
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\\rclone.exe OR *\\Rclone.exe OR *\\RCLONE.EXE) OR @OriginalFileName:rclone.exe) @CommandLine:(*mega\:* OR *--multi-thread-streams* OR *--transfers*) @CommandLine:(*" copy "* OR *" sync "* OR *" move "*)) OR (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:22 @QueryName:(*mega.nz OR *mega.co.nz OR *userstorage.mega.co.nz OR *megaup.net) -@Image:(*\\MEGAsync.exe OR *\\MEGAcmd.exe))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\rclone\.exe$/i OR (CommandLine=/mega:/i AND CommandLine=/(copy|sync|move)\s/i)
| CommandLine=/(--multi-thread-streams|--transfers|--config|--no-check-certificate|mega:)/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| join({
    #event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
    | ImageFileName=/\\(anydesk|rustdesk|ngrok|cloudflared|radmin|meshagent)\.exe$/i
    | groupBy([aid], function={ RmmFirstSeen := min(@timestamp) | RmmTool := collect([ImageFileName]) })
  }, field=aid, include=[RmmFirstSeen, RmmTool])
| RmmDeltaSec := (@timestamp - RmmFirstSeen) / 1000
| RmmDeltaSec >= 0 AND RmmDeltaSec <= 86400
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, RmmTool, RmmDeltaSec, CommandLine], function=count())
| sort(_count, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Distinguishes Akira specifically: rclone-to-Mega is a near-deterministic Akira signature (CISA AA24-109A explicitly calls it out) and pairing it with an RMM-drop within 24h captures the operator's hands-on access pattern. Other rclone users (legit IT, BlackBasta, BlackCat) more commonly target S3/Azure blob; the mega.nz + RMM combo is Akira-unique. The 24h correlation window cuts FPs from sysadmin

ucs.title: [LLM] Akira BYOVD: Zemana/SoftPerfect vulnerable driver loaded prior to .akira mass-encryption
ucs.description: Hunts Akira's EDR-kill primitive — registering or loading a known-vulnerable driver (zam64.sys, zamguard64.sys, wnbios.sys, rentdrv2.sys, gdrv.sys) from a non-vendor path immediately before mass file renames to .akira/.powerranges extensions. Documented by Sophos, S-RM and SentinelOne as the standard Akira/Howling Scorpius pre-encryption sequence used to neutralise AV before deploying the Rust encryptor.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as drv_path from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name IN ("zam64.sys","zamguard64.sys","wnbios.sys","wnbios64.sys","rentdrv2.sys","gdrv.sys","truesight.sys","viragt64.sys") AND NOT (Filesystem.file_path="*\\Zemana\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\SoftPerfect\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\GIGABYTE\\*") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | append [| tstats summariesonly=true count as encrypt_writes min(_time) as encryptFirstSeen values(Filesystem.file_name) as renamed_files from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="*.akira" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.powerranges" OR Filesystem.file_name="akira_readme.txt" OR Filesystem.file_name="fn.txt") by Filesystem.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`] | stats min(firstTime) as driverDrop, min(encryptFirstSeen) as encryptStart, values(file_name) as artefacts, values(renamed_files) as renamed, max(encrypt_writes) as encrypt_writes by dest | where isnotnull(driverDrop) AND isnotnull(encryptStart) AND (encryptStart - driverDrop) <= 3600 | eval delta_min=round((encryptStart - driverDrop)/60,1) | convert ctime(driverDrop) ctime(encryptStart) | table driverDrop, encryptStart, delta_min, dest, artefacts, renamed, encrypt_writes
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let KillWindow = 1h;
let VulnDrivers = dynamic(["zam64.sys","zamguard64.sys","wnbios.sys","wnbios64.sys","rentdrv2.sys","gdrv.sys","truesight.sys","viragt64.sys"]);
let VendorPaths = dynamic([@"\zemana\", @"\softperfect\", @"\gigabyte\", @"\program files\"]);
let DriverDrop =
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
    | where FileName in~ (VulnDrivers)
    | where not(FolderPath has_any (VendorPaths))
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project DropTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DriverFile = FileName, DriverPath = FolderPath,
              DroppedBy = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DroppedByCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessAccountName;
let AkiraEncryption =
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("FileRenamed","FileCreated")
    | where FileName endswith ".akira"
         or FileName endswith ".powerranges"
         or FileName =~ "akira_readme.txt"
         or FileName =~ "fn.txt"
    | summarize EncryptStart = min(Timestamp),
                EncryptCount = count(),
                SampleNote = anyif(FileName, FileName has "readme")
             by DeviceId, DeviceName;
DriverDrop
| join kind=inner AkiraEncryption on DeviceId
| where EncryptStart between (DropTime .. DropTime + KillWindow)
| extend MinutesToEncrypt = datetime_diff('minute', EncryptStart, DropTime)
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceRegistryEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated")
    | where RegistryKey has @"\Services\" and RegistryValueName =~ "ImagePath"
    | where RegistryValueData has_any (VulnDrivers)
    | project DeviceId, SvcKey = RegistryKey, SvcImage = RegistryValueData,
              SvcRegTime = Timestamp
) on DeviceId
| project DropTime, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          DriverFile, DriverPath, DroppedBy, DroppedByCmd,
          SvcKey, SvcImage, EncryptStart, MinutesToEncrypt, EncryptCount
| order by DropTime desc

ucs.datadog_query: (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @TargetFilename:(*\\zam64.sys OR *\\ZAM64.SYS OR *\\zamguard64.sys OR *\\wnbios.sys OR *\\wnbios64.sys OR *\\rentdrv2.sys OR *\\gdrv.sys OR *\\truesight.sys OR *\\viragt64.sys) -@TargetFilename:(*\\Zemana\\* OR *\\SoftPerfect\\* OR *\\GIGABYTE\\* OR *\\Program?Files\\*)) OR (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @TargetFilename:(*.akira OR *.powerranges OR *\\akira_readme.txt OR *\\fn.txt)) OR (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:13 @TargetObject:(*\\Services\\*ImagePath* OR *\\services\\*ImagePath*) @Details:(*zam64.sys* OR *zamguard64.sys* OR *wnbios.sys* OR *rentdrv2.sys* OR *truesight.sys*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| TargetFileName=/\\(zam64|zamguard64|wnbios|wnbios64|rentdrv2|gdrv|truesight|viragt64)\.sys$/i
| NOT TargetFileName=/\\(Zemana|SoftPerfect|GIGABYTE|Program Files)\\/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| join({
    #event_simpleName=FileWritten
    | TargetFileName=/(\.akira$|\.powerranges$|\\akira_readme\.txt$|\\fn\.txt$)/i
    | groupBy([aid], function={ EncryptFirstSeen := min(@timestamp) | EncryptCount := count() })
  }, field=aid, include=[EncryptFirstSeen, EncryptCount])

| sort(EncryptFirstSeen, order=asc)
